meta.name: short-drama-knowhow
meta.description: 维护者专用的短剧 know-how 学习、验证与生命周期治理。仅在维护者明确要求从其当前会话提供的授权只读文本源学习完整短剧项目链，并把私有观察逐步转成去标识、去复刻、经盲测与独立审查的公共 reference、rubric 或 synthetic fixture 候选时使用；不用于普通创作、公开运行时取数、媒体生成或粗略数据分析。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把私有短剧观察整理成可公开验证的参考资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有授权只读的短剧项目资料,想沉淀成可公开的素材。
copy.tagline_en: Turn private short-drama notes into de-identified public references
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hold authorized short-drama material and want to publish safe reference assets

howto.what: 当维护者授权只读文本源后,它逐层通读短剧项目链(简报、剧本、分镜、提示词等),写成私有观察卡与覆盖矩阵,再筛出经盲测和独立审查的去标识公共候选。
howto.when: 仅当维护者明确要求,且当前会话已提供授权只读的短剧文本源时接管;普通创作、媒体生成等场景不适用。

say.text: 从我这轮提供的授权只读剧本开始,做完整项目链的定性通读并写观察卡
say.note: 观察卡留在隔离工作区,不进公共包

say.text: 对候选做 fresh-agent 盲测和独立审查,通过后再 promotion

howto.what_en: Given an authorized read-only source, it reads a short-drama project chain layer by layer (brief, scripts, shot lists, prompts), writes private observation cards, then narrows them into de-identified public candidates.
howto.when_en: Takes over only when the maintainer explicitly asks and the session already provides authorized read-only short-drama text sources; not for ordinary writing or media generation.

say_en.text: Read the authorized scripts from this session and write private observation cards
say_en.note: Cards stay in the isolated workspace

say_en.text: De-identify these private cards into public reference and rubric candidates
say_en.note: Proposals stay in the maintainer staging area

say_en.text: Run a fresh-agent blind eval and independent review before promotion
